issues: Only a 2025-26 catalog is public; no 2026-27 or Semester I catalog found on re-check 2026-11-14 (site still links the 2025-26 file). Despite its title the PDF (created 2026-02-13, 14 slide-format pages) covers only Semester II of 2025-26: a block schedule grid plus full descriptions (driving questions, 'GX' graduate-expectation tags) for ~10 interdisciplinary rotating 'Studio' courses (e.g. American Military History, Chemistry of Color, Survival, Algebra II, World Religions & Belief). Block courses (AP Biology, AP Composition, PE/Health, Spanish, Business Algebra I, art/music/design studios, Crew) appear only as titles. Studio offerings rotate by semester, so this is a semester offering list rather than a stable program of studies. Graduation Handbook Google Doc requires sign-in.
